lines.text: I found a new place for breakfast. It has tables outside by the river.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That sounds lovely. What time does it open on Sunday?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: It opens at nine. My friend said there is a long line after ten.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I would rather go early because I have a class at eleven.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: How about nine fifteen at the bridge? We can walk to the place together.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That works. Could you send me the name of the place in case I am late?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Sure, I will send it now. I have to get back to work, so see you on Sunday.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: See you! I will send you a message when I get to the bridge.
lines.speaker: Eli
